changes: Reuse the same gain for both missing directions when the integer missing sums are zero; retain missing-right ties.

For unconstrained dense numeric tasks with at least 32 bins, reuse conservative gain bounds to discard candidates only when upper < best lower. Keep the original binary64 calculation for survivors and unsupported ranges.
Cache numeric upper bounds in existing category-weight scratch; ensure diagnostic wrapper allocates it for numeric tasks too. Resident training already allocated this buffer.
precision: No arithmetic precision, test tolerance, quantization or tie-breaking change. The existing interval helper is reused.

scalar_split_oracle.comparison: Exact integer children, materialized sums, gain bits, winning bins, missing directions, partitions, category order and output guards. Expanded cases pass on baseline and final candidate; final candidate tested through the focused runner.

correctness.large_workloads: All 12 MPS models, margins and every-round metric histories are exactly equal before/after and to the original high-dimensional experiment. All six CPU controls also reproduce the original CPU outputs. Each MPS worker checks same-model CPU prediction exactly.
correctness.scope: Focused acceptance. The historical full 106-native/4001-Python baseline predates this change. Independent CPU/MPS training still differs; no NVIDIA execution.

training.note: Fresh workers; 100 rounds, 64 informative columns, all columns considered, eight CPU threads. CPU and both MPS variants run sequentially. Require exact saved models and margins from the original high-dimensional runs.

dataset_provenance: validation/high-dimensional-m3.json; identical 64-informative-feature datasets, 100 rounds, depth 6, 256 bins, eight CPU threads. No column subsampling. Train shapes 100000x1024 and 25000x4096; 102400000 training values each.

installed_package.isolation: python -I; cwd outside checkout; no PYTHONPATH or DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH; pytest pythonpath override empty

limits: Warm runtime, fresh worker and matrices. Training includes quantization/evaluation; data generation, matrix setup and final prediction are separate.
GPU counter families can overlap. Do not sum them or subtract their sum from wall time to infer host execution.
This task ran no concurrent builds/tests/other benchmarks during timing. Unrelated sessions and applications were not controlled; swap observations are system-wide.
Dense unconstrained numeric splits benefit from screening; missing-data, categorical and constrained cases retain the full evaluator. Microbenchmark fallback timings and all losses are retained.
One M3, three full-training repeats per variant. These are bounded synthetic workloads, not a claim of general superiority over CPU or CUDA.
